checks.title: Configuration matches documented rules
checks.assumption: README.md and docs/FAIRNESS.md describe the intended rules.
checks.method: Compare MODES hazard counts, stop counts (20−h), total stops (61), wager limits, starting balance and container IDs with documentation.

checks.title: Exhaustive hazard-subset enumeration reproduces survival counts
checks.assumption: A hazard deck is a uniformly random h-subset of {1..20} (follows from an unbiased Fisher–Yates shuffle).
checks.method: Enumerate every h-subset (20 + 1,140 + 15,504 + 184,756 = 201,420). For each stop s count subsets whose minimum exceeds s; compare with C(20−s,h).

checks.title: Conditional loss, cumulative survival and nextRisk() are mutually consistent
checks.assumption: Documented formulas: p_s = h/(21−s), S_s = C(20−s,h)/C(20,h).
checks.method: Exactly verify S_s = Π(1−p_j) for every stop; compare production nextRisk(mode, s−1) with h/(21−s); check nextRisk at the final stop is 0.

checks.title: All 61 multipliers equal round-half-up(98 / S_s) in hundredths; exact ties identified
checks.assumption: docs/FAIRNESS.md: "round(0.98 / survival, 2)"; public/math.js integer hundredths are authoritative.
checks.method: Compute 98·C(20,h)/C(20−s,h) exactly as a rational; round half up; compare with MODES payouts. Detect exact .5 ties (where rounding direction would be ambiguous) and measure the distance to the nearest tie. Also confirm the existing float-based test cannot disagree.

checks.title: Stake split conserves every permitted total wager
checks.assumption: Remainder cents go to A then B (README.md).
checks.method: For every W in 300..300,000 (299,701 values) compare production splitStake(W) with an independent BigInt split; check the sum equals W and max−min ≤ 1 cent.

checks.title: Payout rounding matches BigInt half-up for every reachable stake × multiplier pair
checks.method: For every individual stake w in 100..100,000 cents and all 61 multipliers (99,901 × 61 = 6,093,961 pairs) compare production payout() with BigInt arithmetic. Also confirm the largest intermediate product is a safe integer.

checks.title: Per-stop odds, nominal RTP and exhaustive cent-RTP range
checks.assumption: All surviving containers are collected at the same stop; RTP = S_s·Σg(w_i,s)/W.
checks.method: For each of the 61 stops: exact conditional/cumulative survival, nominal RTP S·M/100, and the exact min/max of S·Σg/W over all 299,701 wagers (BigInt cross-multiplication when products exceed 2^52).

checks.title: Exhaustive optimal-stopping RTP over every permitted wager
checks.assumption: Containers are independent (separate HMAC domains) and the player cannot see future hazards; then the optimum is the sum of single-container optima (proved in audit §6 and checked by M09).
checks.method: For each stake w (99,901 values) find t maximising S_t·g(w,t); for every total W (299,701) sum the three container optima; report the exact maximum RTP and its wager.

checks.title: Joint three-container Bellman optimum equals the factorised optimum
checks.assumption: Container survivals are mutually independent given the documented RNG; within a container hazards are drawn without replacement.
checks.method: Solve the exact joint dynamic program over every (stop, onboard-set) state and every collectable subset with rational arithmetic, for 4 modes × 12 wagers including uneven splits. Require exact equality with the sum of single-container optima.

checks.title: Strategy comparison at a $30 wager ($10 per container)
checks.assumption: Same as M09. Mid = ceil(N/2). Adaptive rule exactly as described in audit §6.
checks.method: Closed-form expectation with exact rationals for each named strategy; independent of simulation.

checks.title: Maximum exposure and final-stop probabilities
checks.assumption: No maximum-win cap exists in the source (confirmed by reading server/game.js and public/math.js).
checks.method: Exact payout at the largest container stake and the final multiplier; P(≥1 reaches final) = 1−(1−S_N)^3, P(all three) = S_N^3.

checks.title: Theoretical variance of return/wager at the final stop (equal stakes, no rounding)
checks.assumption: Survivor count K ~ Binomial(3, S_N); X = m·K/3.
checks.method: Var(X) = m²·S·(1−S)/3 computed exactly with the table multiplier.

checks.title: Rounding effect bound
checks.assumption: RTP deviation from 98% comes only from multiplier rounding (≤ 0.005·S in RTP) and payout rounding (≤ 0.5 cent per container).
checks.method: Exactly verify |S·M/100 − 0.98| ≤ 0.005·S for every stop (multiplier rounding), and that every exhaustive cent-RTP extreme lies within a further S·(1.5 cents / 300 cents) = S/200 of the nominal RTP (payout rounding, ≤0.5 cent per container on a ≥$3 wager).
